summary: Market tone today looks cautiously bullish in crypto, with Miles Deutscher saying he sees a strong crypto market and focusing on concentrated quality setups, while Reuters shows mixed but constructive macro conditions with gold elevated and major US indices slightly softer. The clearest actionable themes from the latest available items are strength in revenue-generating crypto protocols, plus selective interest in altcoins and some bearish macro risk in equities and FX.
